name: Hotel Krone Tirol
beschreibung: Hotel Krone Tirol is situated in Lechaschau in Tyrol's Reutte district. As a long-standing family-run hotel, it offers warm hospitality and traditional alpine charm. Framed by the Lechtal Alps and the wild Lech River, it is an ideal base for Lechweg hiking and winter sports across the Zugspitz Arena. Amenities include a wellness area with an indoor pool and saunas, alongside an on-site restaurant serving hearty regional specialties.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Krone Tirol in Lechaschau near Reutte provides family hospitality, an indoor pool and sauna, regional dining, and easy access to the Lech River and Zugspitz Arena.
